_comment: Airspy R2 only, single-SDR mode covering control + voice in one 10 MS/s window. R2's native 10,000,000 S/s is used as-is: the P25 recorder integer-decimates then arbitrary-ratio-resamples to the 24000 channel rate (4800 baud x 5 sps, Phase I), so the source rate does NOT need to divide evenly by 24000. The real constraint here is Pi 5 CPU: with one wide source, every recorder decimates the full 10 MS/s stream itself. Start digitalRecorders low, watch `top` during a busy hour, then raise. Airspy gain is three osmosdr stages: lnaGain, mixGain, ifGain (each ~0-15). NOTE: the lone RTL-SDR is NOT listed here -- it is dedicated to ADS-B (1090 MHz) outside trunk-recorder.

sources._comment: Airspy R2 in single-SDR mode. Center placed off any active channel; 851-856 voice span fits inside the 10 MHz window (848.7-858.7). VERIFY 853.7 lands on no active control/voice channel for your site before trusting it.
